scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --names bridge,dev --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run codex:bridge:dev" "npm run dev"
scripts.start:all: concurrently --kill-others --names bridge,dashboard --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run codex:bridge" "docker compose up --build"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check && npm run build
